description: Redesign connect_screen.dart into a full Settings screen with five sectioned cards: Server Connection (existing), Playback, Downloads, Appearance, About. Depends on FEAT-001 (SettingsProvider must exist and be registered).
steps: Rewrite lib/screens/connect_screen.dart. Keep all existing state fields (_isTesting, _result), _testConnection(), _formField(), _textField(), and the _ConnectionResult sealed class at the bottom — do not remove or change any of that logic.

Replace the outer layout: remove the branding hero (Hylo title, tagline, CapsulePill row). Replace with a plain Scaffold(backgroundColor: Colors.black) containing a SafeArea > SingleChildScrollView(padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16)) > Column with a 'Settings' page title (fontSize 28, bold, white, left-padded 16) and then the five section cards below it.

Section card helper: create a private _sectionCard({required String title, required List<Widget> children}) widget builder that wraps children in a Container with color Colors.white.withValues(alpha:0.04), borderRadius 20, padding 20, preceded by a section title Text in Color(0xFF888888) with fontSize 11, fontWeight bold, letterSpacing 0.5, left-padded 16, and with 8px gap between title and card, 24px gap between cards.

Server Connection section: title 'SERVER CONNECTION'. Body = exact same widgets from the existing connect form card: Server URL _formField + _textField, Allow Insecure HTTP toggle container, Username _formField + _textField, Password _formField + _textField, connection result banner (conditional), Connect button. Replace hardcoded Color(0xFFF9CC1B) / _yellow references in this section with Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary.

Playback section: title 'PLAYBACK'. Three rows inside the card: (1) Stream Quality label + SegmentedButton<String> with three ButtonSegment entries: value 'high' label 'High', value 'medium' label 'Medium', value 'low' label 'Low'. Selected set = {settings.streamQuality}, onSelectionChanged writes settings.streamQuality = newSet.first. (2) Skip Silence row with label text + Switch(value: settings.skipSilence, onChanged: (v) => settings.skipSilence = v, activeThumbColor: accent, activeTrackColor: accent.withValues(alpha:0.5)). (3) Crossfade row: label 'Crossfade' + value label ('Off' when 0, else '${v}s') on the right, then a Slider(min:0, max:10, divisions:10, value: settings.crossfadeDuration.toDouble(), onChanged: (v) => settings.crossfadeDuration = v.round(), activeColor: accent). Use accent = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary throughout.

Downloads section: title 'DOWNLOADS'. Three rows: (1) Download on Wi-Fi Only: label + Switch(value: settings.downloadOnWifiOnly, onChanged writes settings.downloadOnWifiOnly, activeThumbColor/activeTrackColor use accent). (2) Storage Used: Row with 'Storage Used' label and right-aligned Text('${offlineManager.downloadedSongs.length} files cached', color: Color(0xFF888888)). offlineManager = context.watch<OfflineManager>(). (3) Clear All Downloads: Center(child: TextButton(onPressed: _confirmClearAll, child: Text('Clear All Downloads', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)))). Implement _confirmClearAll(): calls showDialog with an AlertDialog asking 'Clear all downloads?' with Cancel + Confirm (red) actions; on confirm iterates a snapshot of offlineManager.downloadedSongIds and calls offlineManager.deleteDownload(id) for each.

Appearance section: title 'APPEARANCE'. Three rows: (1) Accent Color label above a Row of 5 GestureDetector-wrapped color circles. Each circle is a Container(width:40, height:40, decoration: BoxDecoration(color: theColor, shape: BoxShape.circle, border: Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: settings.accentColor == theColor.value ? 2.5 : 0))). Colors list: [Color(0xFFF9CC1B), Color(0xFF3B82F6), Color(0xFF8B5CF6), Color(0xFF10B981), Color(0xFFEF4444)]. Tapping writes context.read<SettingsProvider>().accentColor = theColor.value. Space circles with SizedBox(width:12). (2) Album Grid: Row label + SegmentedButton<int> with ButtonSegment(value:2, label:Text('2 Columns')) and ButtonSegment(value:3, label:Text('3 Columns')). Selected = {settings.albumGridColumns}, onSelectionChanged writes settings.albumGridColumns = newSet.first. (3) Show Artist in Track Rows: Row label + Switch(value: settings.showAlbumArtistInRow, onChanged writes settings.showAlbumArtistInRow, activeThumbColor/activeTrackColor use accent).

About section: title 'ABOUT'. Two rows in the card: (1) Row with 'Version' label and right-aligned Text('Hylo v1.0.0', color: Color(0xFF888888)). (2) Text('Your music server, built for the drive.', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF555555), fontSize: 12), centered or left-aligned).

At the top of build(), declare: final settings = context.watch<SettingsProvider>(); final navidrome = context.watch<NavidromeService>(); final offlineManager = context.watch<OfflineManager>(); final accent = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary; — remove the static const _yellow field entirely. Update all Switch activeThumbColor/activeTrackColor and button backgroundColor references to use accent/accent.withValues(alpha:...). Add imports for SettingsProvider and OfflineManager.
acceptance_criteria: Settings screen renders five clearly labelled sections: Server Connection, Playback, Downloads, Appearance, About.
All existing connect functionality (fields, toggle, button disabled guard, test connection, result banner) still works exactly as before.
Tapping an accent color circle immediately re-themes the whole app (bottom nav, slider, button).
SegmentedButton for Stream Quality reads and writes SettingsProvider.streamQuality.
SegmentedButton for Album Grid reads and writes SettingsProvider.albumGridColumns.
Clear All Downloads shows a confirm dialog and deletes all downloaded files on confirm.
Storage Used row reflects live downloadedSongs count.
flutter analyze lib returns no issues.
